masking.method: Profile recovery (alpha 0.1, set on the synthetic world). Masking: 642,130 fully in-stock series-days (13 May-25 Jun 2024 window: days 61-90) masked from a first stockout hour drawn from the real distribution to midnight; recoveryWape/Wpe score the hidden demand per series-day. Forecast bias: the same gradient-boosted model trained on raw sales vs recovered demand, scored on in-stock hours of the 7-day evaluation split.
Not run on FRN-LT: the plan's masking test uses FRN-50K.

notes: Stockout shares by hour exclude all-day outages. Sales in FreshRetailNet are scaled, so only ratios and shares are reported.

Masking floor: even knowing each day's true total, splitting it by the intraday profile gives a hidden-demand WAPE of 31.4%; hour-level WAPE is 114% because 62% of in-stock trading hours sell nothing.

Forecast WAPE on in-stock hours: 35.0% (raw sales) vs 32.1% (recovered). On fully in-stock days only, the raw-sales bias is -8.6%: those days are quieter than average, so that view under-states the bias.
The paper's figures (TFT on raw sales, WPE -7.37%; best masked-recovery WAPE 27.62%, TimesNet) use its own protocols and deep models; compare directions, not exact values.
